{{Quote|The Empire's mapping and exploration divisions are attached to the Imperial Navy. These frontier scouts help expand the Empire's borders by identifying worlds primed for conquest or exploitation.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Exploration Corps''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] tasked with the exploration of known regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to locate [[Planet/Legends|planets]] which could be used to supply either resources or personnel. They were a sister branch of the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]]. Its primary training establishment was the [[Imperial Exploration Academy]] in the [[Vanik system/Legends|Vanik system]].
